approaches.hypothesis: One predicate can accept complete short source lines without weakening exact evidence.
approaches.implementation: Require an exact 25-character passage or an exact entire non-empty source line and reuse its wording at prompt and refusal.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Adds line-aware comparison while retaining the existing passage floor.

approaches.hypothesis: Reducing the numeric minimum is sufficient.
approaches.implementation: Accept every exact source passage above a smaller length.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Simpler, but admits arbitrary fragments and still fails shorter complete lines.

approaches.hypothesis: A bounded deliverable-to-producer contract can derive only declared real sources.
approaches.implementation: Resolve one context.up namespace and require every producer named by the tactical_roadmap profile.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: New deliverables require an explicit profile.

approaches.hypothesis: Every sibling object near the deliverable is an upstream producer.
approaches.implementation: Register all non-status sibling state keys automatically.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: No profile maintenance, but invents producer relationships and unstable source sets.

approaches.hypothesis: A full assessment plan can be validated in memory before one state transition.
approaches.implementation: Parse all rows and grounding blocks, validate against a copied matrix, then replace the three run records only after success.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: More parser checks, with no stranded partial ruling set.

approaches.hypothesis: Calling answer-owner row by row is sufficient.
approaches.implementation: Apply each parsed row immediately and stop on the first refusal.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Reuses the CLI helper but can leave earlier rulings filed when a later row is invalid.

approaches.hypothesis: The hand digest is reproducible from immutable reader responses and run registries.
approaches.implementation: Load each seat's stored response spans and render the same ordered line format.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Depends on preserved reader evidence, as the audit contract already requires.

approaches.hypothesis: Quotes retained in matrix.json are enough.
approaches.implementation: Print normalized quotes without reading response spans.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Smaller read surface, but loses exact line numbers and cannot reproduce the source excerpts.
